system.description:
Effect

Range reduced to 120ft but when making a basic light attack, you can make a second light attack for 0 AP.

Effect

Reduces the activation cost by 1 AP.

Effect

You may use the cannon a second time in a round, however this second attack can only be a light attack.

Effect

Mystic Eye attacks made with this lens count as silver.

Effect

You are considered proficient with these even if you normally would not be.

Effect

Nimble instead becomes Nimble Rotation. After attacking you can no longer move away from the enemy, but you can sidestep to anywhere adjacent to the enemy when making a melee attack. This cannot be used if the target is reduced to 0 HP from the attack.

Effect

After making a ranged attack with this weapon, you may move 5ft as if you had the light sword passive (Nimble).

Effect

When you move up a vertical surface from a horizontal one, your first movement of the round does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Effect

If you spend RP dodging an attack of opportunity, you may dodge any other attacks of opportunity made in reaction to the same action as the first for free.

Effect

Reduces the falling speed down to 20ft per round.

Effect

Your range is doubled.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The first switch in an encounter does not consume a shell.

Effect

If you did not move this turn or the previous turn you gain a +1d4 bonus to your accuracy roll on attacks made with this weapon.

name: Snipe — Sniper Rifle (Two-Handed) / Adjustable Lens Refractor Gun / Refractor Gun

system.description:
Effect

If you did not move this turn or the previous turn you gain a +1d4 bonus to your accuracy roll on attacks made with a Sniper Rifle. If you already have the Sniper's Snipe ability, the effect is 4 instead of rolling when used with this weapon.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The range of the ranged mode is increased to 240ft.

Effect

While it's active, you are immune to Slowing effects caused by Frost damage.

Effect

When you roll a 1 on an accuracy roll, you can reroll the attack. Your target(s) can make an opportunity attack, even with a ranged weapon. This opportunity attack does not provoke other opportunity attacks.

Effect

Requires Jury-Rigged Shield. Installs a Sorthen style Shield Generator increasing the shield value by 15 HP.

Effect

When moving at least 40ft towards an enemy, increases the range of your next attack made with this weapon by 5 ft.

Effect

You may treat your shield as a Light weapon. You can use it to make an attack and still gain the shield bonus.

Effect

This weapon also gains the axe passive (Wild Swing). You keep this effect even when throwing the weapon.

Effect

You may move 5ft after making your Heavy attack, but before making your Sweeping Arc attack.

Effect

You do not need to draw and wield this weapon to use it, it is worn in your equipment. However, you can only attack once per round with it. If your first attack with it in a fight is a basic attack, it activates Hidden Weapon as if you drew it right before attacking, though this still does not allow you to benefit from Hidden Weapon multiple times per combat. This weapon can no longer be used to make thrown weapon attacks and cannot be drawn normally. Designed by Nya.

Effect

You gain a +5 bonus to any saves that would knock you prone or knock you back.

Effect

The crit threshold decreases by 1 for each attack made this turn with a Swallow’s Edge weapon. This bonus resets if you land a critical hit. If both your mainhand and offhand weapon have this mod, the effect aplies to both weapons at the same time.

Effect

The grappling hook artifice can be used to swing from the point the pin is embedded instead of pulling straight towards it, in addition the rope length is increased by 20ft. The pin automatically detaches and reels in when you move to your destination for smooth traveling.

Effect

You gain a +2 Swordbreaker Power bonus against targets wielding light blades and heavy blades.

Effect

The zone increases to 30x30ft.

Effect

Adds thermal vision up to 120ft. This cannot detect things hidden by magical means. The sight can not discern a difference in heat once something reaches freezing temperatures.

Effect

Adds thermal vision up to 120ft. This cannot detect things hidden by magical means. The sight can not discern a difference in heat once something reaches freezing temperatures.

Effect

Thermal vision and similar heat based detection no longer automatically detects you.

Effect

Attacks with this weapon gain the Artillery keyword within 30ft.

Effect

You may throw this shield at an enemy within 30ft to make a ranged attack against it. Afterwards, the shield returns to your hand.

Effect

You are treated as Large size (no effect if already large). If you are tiny or small size, it instead increases your size by 1 category.

Effect

The burden of this shield is increased by 1, but it now counts as Low cover for you against ranged attacks.

Effect

You can use this weapon even if you're not proficient with any of the above listed firearms.

Effect

You may attach 3 weapons to this instead of 2.

Effect

If a heavy attack is the first attack used, it grants the damage stack immediately.

Effect

If used underwater, the bubble provided you air as you slowly float upwards.

Effect

Heavy attacks gain 1 additional dice in damage (5d6->6d6) but suffer -1 accuracy on all attacks.

Effect

The knockback effect is now on hit rather than on damage.

Effect

Increases the speed to 50ft but adds Line Movement: The airship may only move in a straight line when making a movement action.

Effect

When you activate the device in combat, you may immediately take the Hide action for -2 AP of its normal cost (min 0).

Effect

Your attacks deal double damage against objects.

Effect

The person who is attuned to the lamp must be present upon its creation, and a bit of their blood or magic must be inserted into the lamp. The soul lamp’s flame’s strength now corresponds to the health of the target, being a bright flame when the target is at 100% HP and becoming a Dim flicker when they are downed.

Effect

In addition to translating, the speaker's voice is also amplified to be heard from over long distances as if shouting.

Effect

Your first basic attack made with this weapon after moving at least 20ft maximizes one dice of your choice instead of rolling.

Effect

You may spend 1 AP to gain 5 temporary HP until the start of your next turn.

Effect

Pinpoint attacks against you reduce 1 less guard.

Effect

Allows the user to install a weapon into the arm, functioning just like the weapon would (takes an errand from artificer to install). The weapon costs burden like normal, but may be drawn or sheathed for 0 AP once per turn.

Effect

You don't suffer any penalties from walking across webs either natural or created through magic or items.

Effect

You may use Nimble (and Nimble II or Nimble Rotation etc if you have those instead) even after making a Heavy or Precise attack.

Effect

You become immovable while on the ground.

Effect

When making 3 separate attacks against a target, the third attack you make with “Weighted Poll Upsetting” knocks the target back 10ft on damage.
